headline.family_guess: Helvetica/Arial Bold Condensed (system sans, heavy weight)
headline.size_rel: 0.055 of frame height per line, 2 lines max

caption.family_guess: same as headline, no separate caption face

layout.host_pos: dead-center, chest-up, static single lockoff shot, laptop lid visible bottom-frame (Apple logo in shot)
layout.safe_zones: bottom 20% reserved for 2-line caption block; top 10% clear
layout.caption_pos: bottom-center, ~78-92% of frame height, centered horizontally, 2 lines

transitions: none - single continuous static shot, no b-roll, no cutaways

themeable: accent2 (unused mostly, could tint background wash)
bg (bookshelf/office backdrop could be swapped for any static set)
